tools.name: Karin Porter-replacement builder (build_ds2.py and modules)
tools.role: VRM fitting to the Porter skeleton, culling, region weight transfer, borrowed Cloth_PBD / Belt_PBD / Hair_PBD particle weights, hair-atlas packing into free cells, paint-atlas corner UVs, facial rig fit with eyelid levers, equipped-boot padding, collapse jobs, ascii writing

tools.name: Decima readers and patchers (ds2rtti.py, graph.py, group.py, patch_core.py, relink.py, make_links.py)
tools.role: streaming graph / link table / whole-group object reading, core field patches the importer leaves stale, in-place link record relinks

tools.name: build_karin.ps1 / make_mod_ds2.ps1 / pack.ps1 / install.ps1
tools.role: imports with success counts, stream-only core checks, core patches, packing from the vanilla graph, development install / restore

tools.name: make_release.py / release/install.ps1
tools.role: redistributable variant (archive + manifest) and the per-group-checked installer that patches the user's own graph and links; one manifest per supported game build, the first whose checks all pass is installed (ported manifests carry an archive byte patch checked by SHA-256)

tools.name: Cross-build port (mapgroups.py, port_release.py, port_verify.py, port_fields.py, corediff.py)
tools.role: maps the mod's groups to a later game build (renumbered IDs), 3-way merges the replaced cores with that build's own changes into an archive patch, re-encodes link edits per record, and checks the port offline object by object and field by field

tools.name: Player data collector (release/collect.ps1, sparse_root.py, dry_verify.py, diagcompare.py)
tools.role: read-only collector a player runs on another build (cut-down DSAR files with full chunk tables, sparse ranges of plain files, fingerprint report), its rebuild into a tool root, the completeness check and the report comparison

tools.name: ds2_pc_mi_022 (id-daemon)
tools.role: export of vanilla meshes / skeletons / textures and import of ascii meshes and DDS into core / stream files

tools.name: Decima_pack_ds2 (id-daemon)
tools.role: packs the mod's core / stream files into one archive and redirects spans / locators in the graph

tools.name: Odradek (ShadelessFox) DS2 build
tools.role: types_1048.json / extensions_1048.json for the RTTI reader; resource browsing and texture export

tools.name: DirectXTex texconv
tools.role: BC1 / BC4 / BC7 conversion for the fixed-size texture slots
